policyRules.condition: any mandatory brief-template field is missing or ambiguous
request mixes Business Central and F&O in one campaign concept
open campaign with same BU + vertical + overlapping topic and window (fresh record)

actionClassTaxonomy.label: Route brief for approval
actionClassTaxonomy.description: Brief is complete, validated and classified; assemble the Word brief and route it to the BU Campaign Lead for explicit approval.

actionClassTaxonomy.label: Request missing information
actionClassTaxonomy.description: Mandatory brief fields are missing or ambiguous; send the requester targeted questions and hold the brief in awaiting_input.

actionClassTaxonomy.label: Flag BC/F&O mix
actionClassTaxonomy.description: The request combines Business Central and F&O in one campaign concept; propose a split and hold for a human decision — never merge silently.

actionClassTaxonomy.label: Flag duplicate/conflict
actionClassTaxonomy.description: An open campaign overlaps this request (BU, vertical, topic, window); surface the conflicting campaign ids for a human decision.

actionClassTaxonomy.label: Escalate unclassifiable request
actionClassTaxonomy.description: BU or vertical cannot be classified from the request and its sources; escalate to the Marketing Lead / Manager.

impactCeiling.tier1: may draft and route briefs and gap requests; no external commitments
impactCeiling.tier2: no approval, rejection or merge decisions — human only
impactCeiling.tier3: any request touching pricing, legal or partner commitments always escalates

reversibilityRules.brief_draft: reversible — versioned document, additive writes only
reversibilityRules.approval_decision: human-owned — the agent never makes it

authorityEnvelope.domainBoundary: Campaign intake only: validate, classify, flag and draft briefs. May not approve briefs, reject requests, alter the quarterly plan, or read/write Salesforce or Pardot.
authorityEnvelope.complianceCeiling: pricing, legal or partner commitments always route to a human

tierThresholds.tier1: missing or ambiguous mandatory fields — gap request to the requester
tierThresholds.tier2: unclassifiable BU/vertical, disputed duplicate flags, BC/F&O mix, or requester unresponsive after two gap requests — Marketing Lead / Manager
tierThresholds.tier3: pricing, legal or partner commitments — Marketing Lead + BU Campaign Lead
